t: Directions: Study the following information carefully and answer the related questions. Following pie-chart represents the percentage distribution of number of quantity of (wheat + rice) sold from different shops. Total quantity (wheat + rice) sold = 95000 kg (Quantity of wheat sold from each shop is 7500 kg more than the quantity of rice sold from respective shop.) What is the difference between quantity of rice sold from shop A and B taken together and quantity of wheat sold from shop E?
e: Quantity of (wheat + rice) sold from shop: A = 28% of 95000 = 26600 kg B = 12% of 95000 = 11400 kg C = 20% of 95000 = 19000 kg D = 18% of 95000 = 17100 kg E = 22% of 95000 = 20900 kg Quantity of wheat sold from shop: A = (26600 + 7500)/2 = 17050 kg B = (11400 + 7500)/2 = 9450 kg C = (19000 + 7500)/2 = 13250 kg D = (17100 + 7500)/2 = 12300 kg E = (20900 + 7500)/2 = 14200 kg Quantity of rice sold from shop: A = 17050 - 7500 = 9550 kg B = 9450 - 7500 = 1950 kg C = 13250 - 7500 = 5750 kg D = 12300 - 7500 = 4800 kg E = 14200 - 7500 = 6700 kg In tabular form: Shop | Quantity sold (in kg) Wheat + rice | Wheat | Rice A | 26600 | 17050 | 9550 B | 11400 | 9450 | 1950 C | 19000 | 13250 | 5750 D | 17100 | 12300 | 4800 E | 20900 | 14200 | 6700 quantity of rice sold from shop A and B taken together = 9550 + 1950 = 11500 kg quantity of wheat sold from shop E = 14200 kg Therefore, difference = 14200 - 11500 = 2700 kg
h: निर्देश: निम्नलिखित जानकारी का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन कीजिये और संबंधित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिये। निम्नलिखित वृत्तीय आरेख अलग-अलग दुकानों से बेची गई (गेहूँ + चावल) की मात्रा के प्रतिशत वितरण को दर्शाता है। बेची गई (गेहूँ + चावल) की कुल मात्रा = 95000 kg (प्रत्येक दुकान से बेची गई गेहूँ की मात्रा, संबंधित दुकान से बेची गई चावल की मात्रा से 7500 kg अधिक है।) एक साथ दुकान A और B से बेची गई चावल की मात्रा तथा दुकान E से बेची गई गेहूँ की मात्रा के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

t: For how many years, the number of female employees who were hired by the company is less than or equal to the average number of female employees who hired by the company in five years?
e:
Number of employees hired in 2012 = 8000 * 20/100 = 1600
Number of male employees hired in 2012 = 5400 * 72/360 = 1080
So, number of female employees hired in 2012 = 1600 - 1080 = 520
Similarly, calculating the remaining data:
| Total | Male | Female
2012 | 1600 | 1080 | 520
2013 | 960 | 675 | 285
2014 | 2240 | 1620 | 620
2015 | 1200 | 900 | 300
2016 | 2000 | 1125 | 875

The average number of female employees who hired by the company in five years = (520 + 285 + 620 + 300 + 875)/5 = 520
For the years 2012, 2013, and 2015, number of female employees who were hired by the company is less than equal to the average number of female employees who were hired by the company in five years.

t: How many chocolate, red velvet and strawberry cakes are together sold on Mon?
e:
Total chocolate cakes sold on Mon and Tue together = 12% of 150 = 18
Total Vanilla cakes sold on Mon and Tue together = 20% of 150 = 30
Total Red velvet cakes sold on Mon and Tue together = 16% of 150 = 24
Total Black forest cakes sold on Mon and Tue together = 24% of 150 = 36
Total Strawberry cakes sold on Mon and Tue together = 28% of 150 = 42

Number of particular type of cake sold on Mon = Number of that type of cake sold on Mon and Tue together - number of that type of cake sold on Tue
Total chocolate cakes sold on Mon = 18 - 10 = 8
Total Red velvet cakes sold on Mon = 24 - 10 = 14
Total Strawberry cakes sold on Mon = 42 - 18 = 24
Required number of cakes = 8 + 14 + 24
= 46

t: Study the given bar- graphs and answer the question that follows. Turnover of Company X (Product-wise: A,B,C,D and E) Approximately what is the share in the total profit enjoyed by A and E together?
e:
Here
Turnover of A = ₹30 lakh
Turnover of E = ₹60 lakh
Profitability percentage of A = 25%
Profitability percentage of E = 25%
Turnover of B = ₹40 lakh
Turnover of C = ₹20 lakh
Turnover of D = ₹50 lakh
Profitability percentage of B = 7.5%
Profitability percentage of C = 20%
Profitability percentage of D = 7.5%
So,
Profit of A = 30 X (25/100)= ₹7.5 lakh
Profit of E = 60 X (25/100)= ₹15 lakh
Profit of B = 40 X (7.5/100)= ₹3 lakh
Profit of C = 20 X (20/100)= ₹4 lakh
Profit of D = 50 X (7.5/100)= ₹3.75 lakh
Total Profit of Company X = 7.5 + 15 + 3 + 4 + 3.75
Total Profit of Company X = ₹33.25 lakh
Share of A and E = (7.5 + 15) / 33.25 X 100%
Share of A and E ≈ 67.67% ≈ 70%

t: Number of employees who is working from home in Product development exceeds the total number of employees who is working from home in HR and Finance departments together by X. The value of X/2 is:
e:
Number of employees in HR department = 400 * 8/100 = 32
Number of employees who is working from office in HR department = 32 * 25/100 = 8
Number of employees who is working from home in HR department = 32 - 8 = 24
Similarly, we can find out the number of employees who is working from office or from home for remaining department.
Department | Total number of employees | Number of employees working from office | Number of employees working from home
HR | 32 | 8 | 24
Finance | 40 | 8 | 32

IT | 100 | 40 | 60
Product Development | 80 | 20 | 60
Sales | 76 | 38 | 38

X = 60 - (24 + 32) = 60 - 56 = 4
Value of X/2 = 4/2 = 2

t: Read the data carefully and answer the following question. Following pie-chart represents the distribution (in degrees) of number of laptops repaired by shops A, B, C, D and E on Monday and Tuesday together out of total 4500 laptops repaired from respective shops during these days. Following table represents the percentage of laptops repaired on Monday out of total laptops repaired on Monday and Tuesday together. Shops | Percentage of laptops repaired on Monday A | 60% B | 45% C | 60% D | 70% E | 35% What is the average number of laptops repaired in shops A, C and D on Tuesday?
e: Number of laptops repaired on Monday and Tuesday together in shop A = (56°/360°) * 4500 = 700 Number of laptops repaired on Monday and Tuesday together in shop C = (40°/360°) * 4500 = 500 Number of laptops repaired on Monday and Tuesday together in shop D = (80°/360°) * 4500 = 1000 Number of laptops repaired on Tuesday in shop A = (100 - 60)% of 700 = 280 Number of laptops repaired on Tuesday in shop C = (100 - 60)% of 500 = 200 Number of laptops repaired on Tuesday in shop D = (100 - 70)% of 1000 = 300 Therefore, the average number of laptops repaired in shops A, C and D on Tuesday = (280 + 200 + 300)/3 = 260
h: आंकड़ों को ध्यान से पढ़ें और निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का उत्तर दें। निम्नलिखित वृतीय आरेख सोमवार और मंगलवार के दौरान संबंधित दुकानों द्वारा मरम्मत किए गए कुल 4500 लैपटॉप में से एक साथ सोमवार और मंगलवार दिनों को दुकान A, B, C, D और E द्वारा मरम्मत किए गए लैपटॉप की संख्या के वितरण (डिग्री में) को दर्शाता है। निम्नलिखित तालिका एक साथ सोमवार और मंगलवार को मरम्मत किए गए कुल लैपटॉप में से सोमवार को मरम्मत किए गए लैपटॉप का प्रतिशत दर्शाती है। दुकानसोमवार को मरम्मत किए गए लैपटॉप का प्रतिशत A60% B45% C60% D70% E35% मंगलवार को दुकान A, C और D द्वारा मरम्मत किए गए लैपटॉप की औसत संख्या कितनी है?

t: The following pie chart shows the degree distribution of number of marbles five children named as A, B, C, D and E have. B lost 20% of his total marbles, D lost 30% of his total marbles, and E, lost 1/4th of his total marbles. C bought 25% more than his total marbles and A gave 40% of his total marbles to E. If D lost 2/5th of his remaining marbles, then the central angle (to the nearest degree) of the sector corresponding to child C in the pie chart will become:
e:
Let the total number of marbles all children together have initially = 360
Number of marbles A has after giving 40% to E = 90 * 60/100 = 54
Number of marbles B has after losing 20% of his total marbles = 60 * 80/100 = 48
Number of marbles C has after buying 25% more = 80 * 125/100 = 100
Number of marbles D has after losing 30% of his total = 50 * 70/100 = 35
Number of marbles D has after losing 2/5<sup>th</sup> of 35 = 35 * 3/5 = 21
Number of marbles E has after losing 1/4<sup>th</sup> of his total = 80 * 3/4 = 60
Number of marbles E has after receiving 36 marbles from A = 60 + 36 = 96
Required angle = 100 * 360/319 = 112.8 = 113°
h: निम्नलिखित वृत्तीय-आरेख A, B, C, D और E नाम के पाँच बच्चों के कंचों की संख्या का डिग्री वितरण दर्शाता है। B ने अपने कुल कंचों का 20% खो दिया, D ने अपने कुल कंचों का 30% खो दिया और E ने अपने कुल कंचों का 1/4 भाग खो दिया। C ने अपने कुल कंचों से 25% अधिक खरीदा और A ने अपने कुल कंचों का 40%, E को दे दिया। यदि D ने अपने शेष कंचों का 2/5 भाग खो दिया, तो वृत्तीय आरेख में बच्चे C के संगत त्रिज्यखंड का केंद्रीय कोण (निकटतम डिग्री तक) कितना बन जाएगा?

t: The table below shows the total number of candidates registered and those who attended the examination at different centers - A, B, and C. Study the table carefully and answer the question that follows. Year | A | B | C Total | Attended | Total | Attended | Total | Attended 2016 | 38 | 28 | 49 | 33 | 49 | 39 2017 | 50 | 48 | 84 | 52 | 53 | 46 2018 | 64 | 60 | 71 | 45 | 65 | 55 2019 | 72 | 66 | 84 | 72 | 80 | 62 2020 | 50 | 34 | 80 | 66 | 90 | 85 'Total' denotes total candidates registered for the centre, 'Attended' denotes the candidates Appeared. In which year was the number of absentees the second highest in total of all centres?
e:
Number of absentees in the year 2016 in all centers together
=> (38 + 49 + 49) - (28 + 33 + 39) = 136 - 100 = 36
Number of absentees in the year 2017 in all centers together
=> (50 + 84 + 53) - (48 + 52 + 46) = 187 - 146 = 41
Number of absentees in the year 2018 in all centers together
=> (64 + 71 + 65) - (60 + 45 + 55) = 200 - 160 = 40
Number of absentees in the year 2019 in all centers together
=> (72 + 84 + 80) - (66 + 72 + 62) = 236 - 200 = 36
Number of absentees in the year 2020 in all centers together
=> (50 + 80 + 90) - (34 + 66 + 85) = 220 - 185 = 35
Number of absentees in 2018 is second highest.

t: Read the data carefully and answer the following question. Following pie-chart represents the population of six cities i.e., P, Q, R, S, T and U. Following table represents the female population of six cities.City | Female population P | 28000 Q | 50000 R | 14000 S | 48000 T | 20000 U | 8000 If male population of city S is 40000 more than the male population of city P, then find the male population of city Q and T together. Note: Total population of city = Total male population of city + Total female population of city
e: Let total population of all six cities together = n Then, total population of city P = 15% of n = 0.15n Total population of city S = 30% of n = 0.3n Male population of city P = 0.15n - 28000 Male population of city S = 0.3n - 48000 Now, 0.3n - 48000 = 40000 + 0.15n - 28000 0.15n = 60000 n = 400000 Total population of city Q = 25% of 400000 = 100000 Total population of city T = 15% of 400000 = 60000 Then, male population of city Q = 100000 - 50000 = 50000 Male population of city T = 60000 - 20000 = 40000 Therefore, male population of city Q and T together = 50000 + 40000 = 90000
h: आँकड़ों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और निम्नलिखित प्रश्न का उत्तर दीजिए। निम्नलिखित वृत्तीय आरेख छह शहरों अर्थात P, Q, R, S, T और U की जनसंख्या को दर्शाता है। निम्नलिखित तालिका छह शहरों की महिला जनसंख्या को दर्शाती है। शहरमहिला जनसंख्या P28000 Q50000 R14000 S48000 T20000 U8000 यदि शहर S की पुरुष जनसंख्या, शहर P की पुरुष जनसंख्या से 40000 अधिक है, तो एक साथ शहर Q और T की पुरुष जनसंख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। नोट: शहर की कुल जनसंख्या = शहर की कुल पुरुष जनसंख्या + शहर की कुल महिला जनसंख्या

h: दिया गया रेखा आरेख छह दुकानों से बेचे गए पेन और लिफाफों की संख्या के औसत को दर्शाता है तथा तालिका प्रत्येक दुकान से बेचे गए पेन और लिफाफों की संख्या के अनुपात को दर्शाती है। दुकानबेचे गए पेन की संख्या और बेचे गए लिफाफों की संख्या का अनुपात A3: 1 B2: 3 C5: 2 D4: 5 E3: 2 F1: 1 यदि एक साथ सभी दुकानों से बेचे गए पेन की कुल संख्या, एक साथ सभी दुकानों से बेचे गए लिफाफों की कुल संख्या से X अधिक है, तो निम्नलिखित में से किस विकल्प द्वारा X विभाजित नहीं हो सकता है?

t: The pie chart shows the percentage distribution of total number of students in all sections of the class. Total number of students in the class = 600 The following line graph shows the total number of boys and girl students present in five sections of a class on a certain day. Total number of students absent in class A and C together is what percent more or less than total number of students absent in class E?
e:
Total number of students in class A = 600 * 20/100 = 120
Total number of students present in class A = 90 + 20 = 110
Total number of students absent in class A = 120 - 110 = 10
Total number of students in class C = 600 * 12/100 = 72
Total number of students present in class C = 30 + 20 = 50
Total number of students absent in class C = 72 - 50 = 22
Total number of students in class E = 600 * 20/100 = 120
Total number of students present in class E = 60 + 40 = 100
Total number of students absent in class E = 120 - 100 = 20

Total population of children in village C = [204800* 16%] - [6000 + 15000] = 11768
Total population of children in village D = [204800* 15%] - [18000 + 9000] = 3720
Total population of children in village E = [204800* 20%] - [18000 + 16000] = 6960

t: A survey was conducted among the employees of 6 companies who eat two meals and three meals in a day. The following line chart 1 shows the number of employees of 6 companies who eat two meals and three meals in a day. Line chart 2 shows the number of males who eat two meals and female employees who eat three meals of 6 companies in a day. Total number of employees = Male employees + Female employees What is the difference between total number of male employees who eat three meals in a day of C1 and C3 to total number of female employees who eat two meals in a day of C4 and C6?
e:
Total number of male employees who eats three meals in a day of C1 = 400 - 50 = 350
Total number of male employees who eats three meals in a day of C3 = 250 - 180 = 70
Total number of male employees who eats three meals in a day of C1 and C3 = 350 +70 = 420
Total number of female employees who eats two meals in a day of C4 = 425 - 200 = 225
Total number of female employees who eats two meals in a day of C6 = 300 - 150 = 150
Total number of female employees who eats two meals in a day of C4 and C6 = 225 + 150 = 375
Required difference = 420 - 375 = 45
h: 6 कंपनियों में एक दिन में दो बार और तीन बार भोजन करने वाले कर्मचारियों के बीच एक सर्वे किया गया। निम्नलिखित रेखा आरेख 1 में 6 कंपनियों में एक दिन में दो बार और तीन बार भोजन वाले कर्मचारियों की संख्या को दर्शाया गया है। रेखा आरेख 2 में 6 कंपनियों में एक दिन में दो बार भोजन करने वाले पुरुषों और तीन बार भोजन करने वाली महिला कर्मचारियों की संख्या को दर्शाया गया है। कर्मचारियों की कुल संख्या = पुरुष कर्मचारियों की संख्या + महिला कर्मचारियों की संख्या C1 और C3 में एक दिन में तीन बार भोजन करने वाले पुरुष कर्मचारियों की कुल संख्या तथा C4 और C6 में एक दिन में दो बार भोजन करने वाली महिला कर्मचारियों की कुल संख्या के बीच का अंतर कितना है?

t: The following bar graph shows the average of number of females in five different organization in 2011 and 2012. The following table shows the ratio of number of females in 2011 to that of in 2012 in five different organization. Organization | Ratio of number of females in 2011 to that of in 2012 P | 4 : 3 Q | 25 : 22 R | 5 : 6 S | 7 : 5 T | 26 : 19 If M = total number of females in 2011 and 2012 in organization Q, N = difference between the number of females in 2011 and 2012 in organization T, and L = difference between the number of females in 2012 in organization R and that of in 2012 in organization S, then find the value of M + N - L.
e:
Let number of females in organization P in 2011 and 2012 be 4X and 3X respectively.
Given,
4X + 3X = 2 * 35
7X = 70
X = 10
So, number of females in organization P in 2011 = 4 * 10 = 40
And number of females in organization P in 2012 = 3 * 10 = 30
Similarly, we can find the number of females in 2011 and 2012 in other organizations.
Organization | Number of females in 2011 | Number of females in 2012
P | 40 | 30
Q | 50 | 44
R | 60 | 72
S | 42 | 30
T | 52 | 38
Now,
M = 50 + 44 = 94
N = 52 - 38 = 14
L = 72 - 30 = 42
Value of M + N - L = 94 + 14 - 42 = 66

t: The following bar graph shows the total export of wheat in 5 consecutive years. Total export of grain = total export of wheat+ total export of maize + total export of rice Total export of all types of grain is same in 5 consecutive years and equal to 500 tonnes. The following table shows the ratio of total export of maize and rice in 5 consecutive years. Years | Ratio of total export of maize to rice 2018 | 4:5 2019 | 4:7 2020 | 3:2 2021 | 5:3 2022 | 8:5 Which of the following statement is correct? I. The ratio of total export of wheat and total export of maize in year 2022 is 3:2. II. The difference between total export of rice in year 2019 and 2018 is 60.
e: For I: Total export of wheat in year 2022 = 240 Total export of rice and maize in year 2022 = 500 - 240 = 260 Total export of maize in year 2022 = 260 * 8/13 = 160 Required ratio = 240:160 = 3:2 For II: Total export of wheat in year 2019 = 280 Total export of rice and maize in year 2019 = 500 - 280 = 220 Total export of rice in year 2019 = 220 * 7/11 = 140 Total export of wheat in year 2018 = 140 Total export of rice and maize in year 2018 = 500 - 140 = 360 Total export of rice in year 2018 = 360 * 5/9 = 200 Required difference = 200 - 140 = 60

t: Read the data carefully and answer the following question. Following pie-chart represents the percentage break-up of number of students in class XI in schools A, B, C and D. Following table represents the ratio of number of girls to boys in class XI in respective schools. School | Ratio of number of girls to boys in class XI A | 2: 3 B | 5: 3 C | 3: 1 D | 4: 5 In school B, if the number of boys in class XI and XII are in the ratio 3: 4 respectively and in school C, the number of girls in class X and XI are in the ratio 1: 2 respectively, then what is the ratio of number of boys in class XII in school B to the number of girls in class X in school C?
e: Let the total number of students in class XI in schools A, B, C and D together = n Then, total number of students in class XI in school B = 16% of n = 0.16n Total number of students in class XI in school C = 32% of n = 0.32n Number of boys in class XI in school B = 0.16n * 3/(3 + 5) = 0.06n Number of girls in class XI in school C = 0.32n * 3/(3 + 1) = 0.24n Now, number of boys in class XII in school B = 0.06n * 4/3 = 0.08n And the number of girls in class X in school C = 0.24n * 1/2 = 0.12n Therefore, ratio = 0.08n: 0.12n = 2: 3

N = Difference between the number of students who attempted test T1, and T3. What is the value of M ÷ N?

t: The following line graph shows the ratio of number of books published by publication A and B over the given years. e:
Ratio of the number of books published by A in 2011 to that by B in 2011 = 1.5 = 3/2
Let number of books published by A in 2011 = 3X
According to the question,
3X = 240 * 125/100
3X = 300
X = 100
So, number of books published by B in 2011 = 300 * 2X/3X = 200
Therefore, number of books published by A in 2012 = 200 - 2 = 198
Given, ratio of the number of books published by A in 2012 to that by B in 2012 = 1.1 = 11/10
11 units = 198
10 units = 198 * 10/11 = 180
Number of books published by B in 2012 = 180

t: Study the table carefully and answer the given question- Table shows the number of male and female and per cent of children(which are not considered in male or female population) with respect to total population in a locality over the years. Year | Number of Male | Number of Female | Per cent of Children 1991 | 550 | 400 | 24% 1992 | 300 | 295 | 30% 1993 | 440 | 440 | 20% 1994 | 407 | 250 | 27% Find the difference between total number of people in the locality in the year 1993 and the number of children in the locality in the year 1991, 1992 and 1994 together.
e:
In 1993 per cent of male and female together = 100 - 20 = 80% of total population in 1993 = 440 + 440 (Given)
=> 80% of total population in 1993 = 880
=> Total population in 1993 = 880 * 100/80 = 1100
Number of children in the year 1991 = (550 + 400) * 24/(100 - 24) = 300
Number of children in the year 1992 = (300 + 295) * 30/(100 - 30) = 255
Number of children in the year 1994 = (407 + 250) * 27/(100 - 27) = 243
Total children = 300 + 255 + 243 = 798
Difference = 1100 - 798 = 302

t: The following pie chart shows the percentage of students applied for a scholarship test from four different states - state A, state B, state C and state D. e:

Number of boys applied from state B = 760 * 11/19 = 440
Number of girls applied from state B = 760 - 440 = 320
Number of student applied from state C = 4000 * 31/100 = 1240
Number of boys applied from state C = 1240 * 2/5 = 248 * 2 = 496
Number of student applied from state D = 4000 * 27/100 = 1080

t: The following bar graph shows the ratio between the numbers of R.O and mixers sold by five different salespersons named A, B, C, D, and E from March to May. h: निम्नलिखित दंड आरेख मार्च से मई तक A, B, C, D और E नाम के पांच अलग-अलग सेल्सपर्सन द्वारा बेचे गए R.O. और मिक्सर की संख्या के बीच के अनुपात को दर्शाता है। R.O. और मिक्सर की संख्या का अनुपात = RO के लिए दर्शाया गया मान/मिक्सर के लिए दर्शाया गया मान निम्न तालिका मार्च से मई तक पाँच अलग-अलग सेल्सपर्सन द्वारा बेचे गए R.O. की संख्या को दर्शाती है। सेल्सपर्सनबेचे गए R.O की संख्या A15 B9 C12 D7 E9 एक साथ सेल्सपर्सन A और B द्वारा बेचे गए मिक्सर की संख्या, एक साथ सेल्सपर्सन C और D द्वारा बेचे गए मिक्सर की संख्या से कितने प्रतिशत अधिक या कम है?

t: The given pie chart shows the amount of money (%) spent (in degrees) on various sports by a sports academy in a particular year. Study the pie chart and answer the question that follows. If ₹42,000 were spent on Soccer, then the money spent on Badminton, Tennis and Rugby taken together is what percentage (rounded off to 2 decimal places) more/less than the money spent on Cricket, Swimming and Hockey taken together?
e:
According to question,
35° = ₹42000
1° = 42000/35
Badminton + Tennis + Rugby = (45 + 65 + 25)° = 135°
135° = 42000/35 * 135 = ₹162000
Cricket + Swimming + Hockey = (100 + 60 + 30)° = 190°
190° = 42000/35 * 190 = ₹228000
Required percentage = (228000 - 162000)/228000 * 100 ≈ 28.95%
Express method :
Badminton + Tennis + Rugby = (45 + 65 + 25)° = 135°
Cricket + Swimming + Hockey = (100 + 60 + 30)° = 190°
Required percentage = (190 - 135)/190 * 100 ≈ 28.95% less

t: Following first pie-chart represents the percentage break-up of the number of employees in company P, Q, R, S and T; and the second pie-chart represents the percentage break-up of the number of male employees in company P, Q, R, S and T. Total number of employees in company P, Q, R, S and T together = 5500 Number of male employees in company P, Q, R, S and T together = 3500 In which of the following companies, the number of female employees is a multiple of 15?
e:
Total number of employees in company P = 16% of 5500 = 880
Number of male employees in company P = 22% of 3500 = 770
Then, number of female employees in company P = 880 - 770 = 110
Similarly,
Company | Number of employees
Total | Male | Female
P | 880 | 770 | 110
Q | 550 | 630 | 80
R | 1320 | 700 | 620
S | 1540 | 490 | 1050 (multiple of 15)
T | 1210 | 910 | 300 (multiple of 15)
Hence, the number of female employees in company S and T is a multiple of 15.

t: The following line graph shows the percentage increase in the number of employees in four departments - A, B, C and D from year 2002 to year 2003. The number of employees in departments A and C in 2002 were in the ratio 2: 3 respectively and number of employees in department C in 2003 was 135 more than that in department A in 2003. Find the total number of employees in departments A and C together in 2002.
e:
Let number of employees in department A in 2002 = 2x
And number of employees in department C in 2002 = 3x
Number of employees in department A in 2003 = 2x + 2x * (20/100) = 12x/5
Number of employees in department C in 2003 = 3x + 3x * (25/100) = 15x/4
Given,
(15x/4) - (12x/5) = 135
(75x - 48x) = 135 * 20
27x = 135 * 20
x = 5 * 20 = 100
Total number of employees in departments A and C together in 2002 = 2x + 3x = 5x = 500

e:
The average number of vehicles from 2010 to 2015 = (307 + 270 + 250 + 289+ 310 + 416)/6 = 307 thousands
The number of vehicles to be manufactured by B in 2016 = 307 * 170/100 = 521.9 thousands

If the ratio of exports to the imports of companies S and U in the year 2015 is 3 : 2 and 1 : 2, respectively, then, the total Imports (in ₹ lakhs) of companies S and U together in the year 2015 is:
e:
Export:Import of S in 2015 is 3:2, and
Export:Import of U in 2015 is 1:2
Export of S(in lakhs) in 2015 is 51
So Import of S (in lakhs) in 2015 = (51/3)*2= 34
Export of U (in lakhs) in 2015 = 70
Import of U (in lakhs) in 2015 = (70/1)*2= 140
So total imports (in lakhs) = 34 + 140 =174
Option (b) is the correct answer.

t: Study the given graph and answer the question that follows. The graph shows the sales of three products: P, Q and R by four companies: A, B, C and D. What percentage is the total production by company C, of the total production by company A?
e:
Total production by company A = Sales of R + Sales of Q + Sales of P
Total production by company A = 9 + 6 + 8 = 23
Total production by company C = Sales of R + Sales of Q + Sales of P
=> 8 + 9 + 6 = 23
Percentage = (Total production by company C / Total production by company A) X 100
=> (23 / 23) X 100 = 100%

t: The following pie charts show the result of a survey. A survey conducted on 3000 people staying in various societies and having various favourite movies. If the favourite movie of 40% people of society Q is D, then what will be the ratio of people who like movie D except society Q to total number of people staying in society S?
e:
Number of people who like movie D in society Q = 3000 * (120/360) * (40/100) = 400
Total number of people who like movie D = 3000 * 20/100 = 600
Number of people except society Q like movie D = 600 - 400 = 200
Total number of people staying in society S = 3000 * 90/360 = 750
Required ratio = 200: 750 = 4: 15

t: The following pie chart shows the percentage break-up of the number of pages read on Sunday and the table given below shows the number of pages read on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday by 6 persons. e:
Average number of pages read by Ojaswi in all 4 days together = 20
Number of pages read by Ojaswi on Sunday = 4*20 - 10 - 9 - 11 = 50

t: Following table shows amount invested by five partners in a business for same time period Partners | Investment P | 9000₹ Q | 15000₹ R | 12000₹ S | 21000₹ T | 18000₹ Answer following question based on above information: If they all together make a total profit of 25000₹, calculate the profit earned by P and R together?
e:
Ratio of investment made by all = P: Q: R: S: T =
9000: 15000: 12000: 21000: 18000 = 9: 15: 12: 21: 18 = 3: 5: 4: 7: 6
Share of profit would be equivalent to share of investment, thus
P's share of profit = (3/25) x 25000 = 3000₹
R's share of profit = (4/25) x 25000 = 4000₹
Total = 3000+4000 = 7000₹

t: The following pie chart shows the distribution (degree wise) of marbles in five jars. Total number of marbles in all jars together = 4680 If 2/3rd of 25% of marbles from jar C are taken and put in jar E, then the difference between the total number of marbles in jar D and jar E becomes:

t: Two pie charts are given below. There are six sport academies in a city. Pie chart-1 shows the percentage distribution of males in these six academies. Pie chart-2 shows the percentage distribution of females in these six sport academies. Number of females in a particular sport academy is shows as a percentage of total number of females in these 6 sport academies. Average number of males in sport academies O and Q together is 820, and average number of females in sport academies P and R together is 360, then what is the difference between the total of number of males in sport academies M, N, and P together and the total number of females in sport academies N, O, and Q together?
e:
The total of number of males in sport academies M, N, and P together = 2 * 820 * 100/(16 + 25) * (22 + 12 + 10)/100 = 1760
The total number of females in sport academies N, O, and Q together = 2 * 360 * 100/(25 + 20) * (21 + 10 + 15)/100 = 736
So, required difference = 1760 - 736 = 1024

t: The following pie charts shows the percentage distributions and degree-wise distributions of insurance sold by five salesmen in May and June. 1% = 5
100% = 500

Difference = 35% of 675 - 27% of 675

t: The given histogram represents the frequency distribution of patients admitted in 250 hospitals in a month: The number of hospitals in which patients admitted more 450 but less than 600 is what percentage more or less than the number of hospitals in which patients admitted less than 400?

t: If 20% people do not like any cold drinks and 640 people like Sprite, then how many people do not like any cold drink?

P = (640000)/(16x 8)
= 5000
Number of people who do not like any cold drink = 0.2 x 5000 = 1000

h: निम्नलिखित जानकारी का ध्यानपूर्वक अध्ययन करें और संबंधित प्रश्न का उत्तर दें। निम्नलिखित वृत्तीय-आरेख विभिन्न शहरों से समाचार चैनल के दर्शकों की संख्या के प्रतिशत वितरण के संबंध में आंकड़े दर्शाता है। शहर P और शहर R से संयुक्त दर्शक, शहर S और शहर U से संयुक्त दर्शकों से अनुमानित कितना प्रतिशत कम है?

t: The table given below shows the number of three types of vehicles sold by a company in three different months and the pie chart shows the unsold vehicles in those months together. Number of unsold bicycles in all three months together = 20% of 350 = 70

e:

t: Below pie charts show the export of five different food grains (Barley, rice, wheat, corn, and millet) from India in 2017 and in 2018: If export of corn in 2017 is 165 million tonnes and export of rice in 2018 is 256 million tonnes, then what is the ratio of export of millet in 2017 to that in 2018?
e:
Total exports of food grains in 2017 = (100/22) * 165 = 750 million tonnes
And total exports of food grains in 2018 = (100/32) * 256 = 800 million tonnes
Required ratio = (750 * 25/100): (800 * 15/100) = 25: 16
h: नीचे दिए गए वृत्तीय आरेख वर्ष 2017 और वर्ष 2018 में भारत से पांच अलग-अलग खाद्यान्न (जौ, चावल, गेहूं, मक्का और बाजरा) के निर्यात को दर्शाते हैं: यदि वर्ष 2017 में मक्का का निर्यात 165 मिलियन टन और वर्ष 2018 में चावल का निर्यात 256 मिलियन टन है, तो वर्ष 2017 और वर्ष 2018 में बाजरा के निर्यात का अनुपात कितना है?

t: The number of students of height equal or more than 160 cm but less than 175 cm is what percent of number of students of height equal or more than 170 cm? (Up to one correct decimal)

Required percentage = 43 * 100/26= 165.4%

t: Study the data carefully and answer the following question: The below pie charts show the percentage distribution of students who play five different sports (Soccer, Golf, Swimming, Boxing, and Karate) from two states (Maharashtra and Gujrat): If number of students who play Golf from Maharashtra and Gujrat are 12000 and 1920, respectively, then what is the ratio of number of students who play boxing and soccer together from Maharashtra to the number of students who play swimming and Karate together from Gujrat?

Total number of students from Maharashtra = 12000 * 100/25 = 48000

h: निर्देश: निम्नलिखित आयत चित्र एक वजन मशीन द्वारा एकत्र किए गए आँकड़ों को दर्शाता है। मशीन पर एक दिन में वजन मापने वाले व्यक्तियों के वजन के संदर्भ में व्यक्तियों की संख्या को नीचे दर्शाया गया है। 65 kg या उससे अधिक वजन वाले व्यक्तियों की संख्या और 45 kg या उससे अधिक, लेकिन 55 kg से कम वजन वाले व्यक्तियों की संख्या का अनुपात है:

t: The given pie-chart shows the data on A, B, O, and AB blood groups of 240 donors. Study the chart and answer the question that follows. What is the ratio of the average donors of blood groups 'A', 'O', and 'AB' to the donors of blood group 'B'?

h: नीचे दिया गया पाई चार्ट एक बेकरी में प्रति केक विभिन्न स्वादों के केक की लागत को दर्शाता है और नीचे दिया गया रेखा ग्राफ बेकरी द्वारा बेचे गए केक की संख्या को दर्शाता है। बेकरी द्वारा बेचे गए वेनिला केक और चॉकलेट केक की कुल लागत के बीच अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Table shows the percent of amount spent by a person on different fruits.Articles | Per cent of Amount spend Apple | 20% Orange | 10% Papaya | (20/3)% Guava | 10% Grapes | (40/3)% Cherry | 40% Total amount spent on Papaya and Guava together is Rs.125. e:

Total amount spent on Orange = 125 * [10/(50/3)] = Rs.75
Amount of oranges = 75/25 = 3 kg
h: तालिका अलग-अलग फलों पर एक व्यक्ति द्वारा खर्च की गई राशि का प्रतिशत दर्शाता है | सामग्रीप्रति राशि खर्च का प्रतिशत सेब20% नारंगी10% पपीता(20/3)% अमरूद10% अंगूर(40/3)% चेरी40% पपीता और अमरूद को साथ मिलाकर खर्च की गई कुल राशि 125 रुपये है | यदि नारंगी का क्रय-मूल्य 25 रूपये प्रति किग्रा है, तो व्यक्ति द्वारा कितने किलोग्राम नारंगी खरीदी गई ?

t: The first bar graph given below shows the production of apples and oranges (in kg) in five years and the second bar graph shows the production of mangoes (in kg) in those years. h: निर्देश : दिया गया वृत्तीय आरेख एक व्यक्ति द्वारा अपनी यात्रा में विभिन्न वाहनों द्वारा तय की गई दूरी को कुल दूरी के प्रतिशत के रूप में दर्शाता है। वृत्तीय आरेख के केंद्र में 'ऑटो द्वारा तय की गई दूरी' द्वारा बनने वाला केंद्रीय कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
